in_sanskrit.name: Bijen
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Seed, Beginning
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bijen एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Bijen is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Bija’ which means ‘seed’. This name signifies the beginning or origin of something. In Hindu mythology, Bijen is also the name of the divine goddess of fertility and prosperity.
